update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Periodic metric collection interval in seconds. This does not control the standalone ceph-exporter 5-second default refresh on Reef 18 and later or the ceph-mgr Prometheus 15-second default cache refresh.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Recheck interval in seconds. Zero disables retries.

function_only.title: Function-only mode
function_only.description: Run only on-demand Functions, without creating charts or making periodic metric requests.

url.title: Dashboard URL
url.description: Base URL of the Ceph Dashboard API. Standby-to-active MGR redirects are resolved securely.

timeout.title: HTTP timeout
timeout.description: Deadline in seconds for one logical Dashboard operation, including discovery, authentication, retries, and response decoding.

not_follow_redirects.title: Reject redirects
not_follow_redirects.description: Reject every Dashboard redirect instead of using Ceph active-MGR discovery.

allowed_redirect_origins.title: Trusted active-MGR origins
allowed_redirect_origins.description: Exact scheme and host origins that may receive Dashboard login credentials or bearer tokens after credentialless active-MGR discovery. The configured URL origin is always trusted implicitly.

vnode.title: Vnode
vnode.description: Associate this once-per-cluster job with a configured Virtual Node. Functions remain attached to the physical Agent job.

username.title: Dashboard username
username.description: Username sent in the Ceph Dashboard JSON login request. This is not HTTP Basic authentication.

password.title: Dashboard password
password.description: Password sent only in the Ceph Dashboard JSON login request.

bearer_token_file.title: Bearer token file
bearer_token_file.description: Path to an externally managed Dashboard bearer token. Takes priority over username/password. The file owner must replace the token before it expires; the collector rereads the file for every request, so replacements take effect without a restart.

osd_selector.title: OSD selector
osd_selector.description: Simple-pattern selector matched against osd.<id> or OSD UUID before the cap.

max_osds.title: Maximum OSDs
max_osds.description: Maximum selected OSDs with individual charts. If the selected set exceeds this operator policy, no per-OSD metrics are collected.

pool_selector.title: Pool selector
pool_selector.description: Simple-pattern selector matched against pool names before the cap.

max_pools.title: Maximum pools
max_pools.description: Maximum selected pools with individual charts. If the selected set exceeds this operator policy, no per-pool metrics are collected.

force_http2.title: Force HTTP/2
force_http2.description: Force HTTP/2, including h2c over plain TCP.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Additional HTTP headers. Authorization, Cookie, and Host are managed by the collector and rejected here.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate and hostname verification. This is insecure and defaults on only for compatibility with self-signed Ceph Dashboard deployments.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Absolute path to a CA bundle.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Absolute path to a client certificate.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Absolute path to a client private key.

bearer_token_file.ui:help: The token is sent only after credentialless active-MGR discovery and takes priority over Dashboard JSON login. Its external owner must replace it before expiry; the file is reread for every request.

autodetection_retry.ui:help: How often Netdata retries a job that failed its initial Dashboard/API check. Zero disables retries.
